root_idea.summary: A root centered on downward movement or descent from a higher to a lower position.
root_idea.development: The spatial idea extends to being lowered in status, suffering diminution or bodily depletion, and to nouns for places or things associated with descent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The QAC imperfect/imperative lemma is normalized to the Form I perfect citation form هَبَطَ.

senses.definition: To descend or go down from a higher place, including to enter a lower region or locality.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for physical descent, whether movement from above, descent into a place, or falling downward. The Quranic usage includes both commands to go down and the descent of a created thing.

senses.definition: To be brought down from a higher standing or condition, with an implication of lowering, abasement, or humiliation.
senses.usage_conditions: When used of human beings, the descent may be depreciative rather than merely spatial; the Quran-focused lexical discussion contrasts this lowering nuance with the more honorific uses associated with إِنزال.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to descend; to cause someone to enter a locality or to alight at a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction corresponding to the intransitive verb of descent; it may be used of a person, an object, or a movement into a town or country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall into evil or become low, abject, mean, or vile; to become lowly or submissive from fear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to a person or group, distinct from ordinary physical descent and from mere quantitative decrease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer or cause a decrease, loss, or reduction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of wealth, goodness or beneficence, livestock, flesh or fatness, and the price of a commodity; disease may reduce a person's flesh, and a price may fall below its former rate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adjust or arrange the counterpoising portion of a load so that it is even or easy upon a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction concerning the balancing of a camel's load.
A distinct lexical use recorded without a spatial or figurative lowering sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low or depressed piece of land or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun denoting ground opposite in elevation to a raised or ascending tract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A declivity or place of descent, by which one descends from a higher to a lower place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a descending place or slope, rather than the act of descending itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or emaciated from disease, poor nourishment, or insufficient care.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to camels and other animals, including a she-camel whose body has become lank or diminished in fatness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where revelation descends; an established designation for Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional place-expression rather than a general description of every site of descent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose state or condition has become unsound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participial use describing deterioration of a person's condition.
